source_frame.current_worktree_note: Candidate contains only the test module change. The source/test paths were read back from the candidate commit. Shared worktree is dirty in parallel lanes; those changes are not included.

property_and_behavior.property: GCMQuery must run over a fitted SCM whose training payload and fit provenance come from the actual persisted selected GCMFit producer route. The fixture must not self-label an unfitted schema 1.2 model as fitted.
property_and_behavior.pre_repair: The shared _simple_scm fixture constructed a schema-1.2 model with fit_method=gcm but no graph source disposition or GCM training provenance. Three selectors failed during fixture validation before reaching GCMQuery, so they provided no evidence for B224/B225.
property_and_behavior.candidate_behavior: The test module creates 400 synthetic observations, CAS-writes SCMFitData, registers the HybridSCMFit method, invokes run_job with the actual source ArtifactRef inside causal_worker_execution_context, reloads canonical method-result bytes into StructuralCausalModelSpec, validates source graph disposition/training row hash/fit provenance through validate_persisted_gcm_spec, then uses the persisted fitted model in query tests.
real_chain: synthetic controlled DGP and SCMFitData source payload
MethodRegistry HybridSCMFit and run_job dispatch to the selected DoWhy worker
canonical persisted method result reloaded into StructuralCausalModelSpec and source-bound validation
GCMQuery consumer asserts intervention/counterfactual/soft-law behavior and active-node set
behavioral_controls: Atomic do(X=2) yields E[Y] approximately 7 for the declared synthetic DGP; active ancestor W remains and disconnected Z is pruned unless full trace is requested.
Conditioned counterfactual retains its declared behavior.
Shifted and truncated soft interventions use the declared stochastic laws.
Malformed stochastic-law input is refused by the query path.
Unsupported post-nonlinear mechanism surfaces fallback warning.
512 draws from truncnorm(0,1,8,10) stay strictly inside the interval and are unique, checking against endpoint clipping/atoms.
property_and_behavior.divergent_case: A constructor-only or self-labeled schema-1.2 model fails graph-source/provenance validation before query execution. The new tests exercise the producer, persisted selected bytes, and consumer, while direct invalid source input still refuses.
property_and_behavior.class_limits: This synthetic fixture validates software query semantics only. It does not prove real-world causal identification, calibration, qualifying production workload, policy efficacy, or institutional authority.
